base.description: The commit the gate would compare the checkout's branch against, as a full object name. Absent when yak can work none out.

folders.description: The folders, each relative to `root` with forward slashes. The first is `.`, the root itself; the rest are the workspace roots.

truncated.description: True when detection stopped at its limit of folders, so `folders` is not the whole workspace.

detection.description: The folders yak looked in for stacks: the checkout root and the workspace roots.

formatVersion.description: The hand-off format. It rises only when the format breaks.

root.description: The checkout's root: absolute, with symbolic links resolved, as the operating system spells it. It is the root to analyze, whatever directory the tool was started in.

siblings.description: The folder this file lies in, absolute. Every file in it whose name ends in `.json` is the hand-off file of one checkout of the same repository, for the same tool server. A reader finds a checkout's file by its `root`, never by its name: a file's name means nothing, and a file still being written has another ending.

interfaceVersion.description: The interface version the stack's declarations file says it was written for. Absent only when the stack has no declarations file for this tool server; `pack` and `project` are then empty.

pack.description: The pack's declarations for this tool server: each key with its value, any JSON. yak passes them through and reads no key.

project.description: The project's own declarations under this stack, kept apart from the pack's: each key with a list of globs or paths, or a positive whole number.

items.description: One stack and the declarations it carries for this tool server.

stacks.description: The stacks that carry declarations for this tool server, in the stacks' order. The stack whose audit is running is always among them.

description: What yak hands a tool server for one checkout: where the checkout is, where yak looked for stacks, and the declarations in force, with the pack's and the project's kept apart. yak replaces the file whole each time it runs the tool. A reader ignores a top-level field it does not know.
title: yak hand-off file, format 1
